name: Distalmotion
description: Distalmotion SA is a medical robotics company founded in 2012 as a spin-off from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne (EPFL) in Epalinges (Lausanne), Switzerland. The company develops the [Dexter](/robot/distalmotion_dexter) on-demand hybrid robotic surgery platform for minimally invasive laparoscopic procedures.
